scope: Native cross-rig weight transfer with verified joint identity, preserving the recipient skeleton and source attachment.

native_cases: Reordered joints matched by name and renamed joints matched by declared humanoid role
Recipient rest rig, inverse binds, pose, morphs, paint and weight locks preserved
Exact native Undo and Redo, repeat is a no-op, and incompatible ancestry is refused
Zero sampled unmatched influences are accepted and nonzero unmatched influences refuse the transaction
Foreign transfer keeps the original avatar link, bind matrices, paint, morph and pose on native reopen

limits: Joint correspondence requires authenticated original identities, declared humanoid roles or hierarchy-compatible exact names. Arbitrary rigs still need manual mapping.
Joint identity and native weight publication run on the host. The existing source BVH query uses the selected GPU. The CPU reference is headless test code.
This milestone qualifies Intel Arc. Physical OpenXR, CUDA and ROCm device runs were outside this qualification.
